build.name: pip install the acquired source (+ pinned deps)
build.cmd: SETUPTOOLS_SCM_PRETEND_VERSION=3.1.6 pip install -q numpy . 2>&1 | grep -v -i 'notice\|warning' | tail -2; python -c 'import sys; print(sys.version.split()[0])'

runs.name: gaussian (Techne harness, oracle-backed; same-container install + run)
runs.cmd: SETUPTOOLS_SCM_PRETEND_VERSION=3.1.6 pip install -q numpy . 2>&1 | grep -v -i 'notice\|warning' | tail -2 >/dev/null; python $HARNESS/gaussian.py

notes: Oracle: sampling a 5-d correlated Gaussian with known covariance; sample mean within 0.1 and covariance within 15% relative, acceptance fraction in a healthy band.
